title: phegopteris sandwicensis
intro: Phegopteris sandwicensis, commonly known as the Hawaiian maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern native to Hawaii, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phegopteris sandwicensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer effects.
